scope: Unified iOS audit: React Native home and Bot-roster list remediation
measurementClass: source-derived operation analysis plus local Bun microbenchmark

variantA.label: replaced linear lookup
variantA.algorithm: Array.find for every pinned id plus Array.includes for every rendered channel

variantB.label: indexed lookup
variantB.algorithm: one Map build and P map lookups plus one Set build and N set lookups

homePinnedLookup.parity: Both variants returned all 1,100 rows in the same explicit pinned-id order; missing ids remain skipped.

variantA.label: eager ScrollView roster
variantA.sourceBehavior: The screen mapped every eligible Bot to a React element before display.

variantB.label: searchable native virtual list
variantB.sourceBehavior: FlatList or SectionList creates a bounded initial batch and renders later rows on demand.

botRoster.reachability: A pure selector test finds Bot 999 by name and description and Bot 742 by title; an unfiltered selector returns all 1,000 Bots in source order.

primaryActionReachability.variantA: Create and Save were list footers after every roster row, placing the action at least 58,000 points below 1,000 minimum-height member rows.
primaryActionReachability.variantB: When a roster exceeds the 12-Bot compact threshold, Create or Save is a flex-bounded sibling below the virtual list inside the safe-area/keyboard-avoiding layout; it remains on screen while roster rows scroll.
primaryActionReachability.smallRosterParity: At 12 or fewer Bots the original in-list footer placement is retained.
primaryActionReachability.semanticParity: The same Pressable element and loading, disabled, warning, error, saved, and destructive-delete semantics are reused; only its large-roster placement changes.
primaryActionReachability.verification: Source parity tests require conditional sticky placement and flex-bounded lists on both New Group and Group Details. Native geometry was not measured because an iOS runtime was unavailable.

botRoster.smallRosterParity: Search controls are omitted at 12 or fewer Bots, preserving the prior compact layout for normal-size fixtures.

homeRender.variantA: A DateTimeFormat instance was allocated during each visible time-label call and channel rows were not memoized.
homeRender.variantB: One module-scoped formatter is reused; channel and pinned rows are memoized against visible fields and receive stable action callbacks.

validation.combinedTypecheckAtCapture: blocked by concurrent API-owner edits in openbot-context.tsx; no errors were reported in this artifact's owned files

limitations: Microbenchmarks measure selector work on the local JavaScript runtime, not Hermes on an iPhone.
Virtual-list mount counts are configuration-derived; React Native may retain additional cells based on viewport and interaction state.
UI parity here is enforced by source and behavior tests. Native screenshot and frame-time validation belongs to the combined simulator/device pass.
